about_the_game:
Workplace Hazard is a fast-paced, precision-driven 2D platformer where you remotely control a Boxbot for the BoxBot Company — cleaning up an abandoned, corporate-run bio-lab packed with crates, chaos, and questionable safety standards.

Your mission: collect crates, and recover lost data as quickly and cleanly as possible. You’re on the clock, and the boss is watching. Break protocol (or the bot), and it’s coming out of your paycheck!

Each stage ramps up the pressure with jump pads, moving platforms, locked doors, and logic-based puzzles - potentially leaving you one wrong move away from starting over.

This isn’t about survival. It’s about efficiency, mastery, and shaving seconds off each run.

Every second matters, and there’s always a faster way.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DX12-compatible GPU (e.g., Intel UHD 620 / NVIDIA GT 1030 / Radeon R7 250)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 165 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible audio device (onboard audio is fine, e.g., Realtek HD Audio)
  • VR Support: N/A
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (8th gen+) / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (e.g., NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 or better) with full DX12 support
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 165 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Dedicated or high-quality onboard sound card with stereo output and driver support for 48kHz or higher
  • VR Support: N/A

short_description: Are you an old CRT monitor with a pension for picking up boxes? Do you long for the days when you could place those boxes in an exit portal and engage your jetpacks early because you're impatient? If you answered yes to any of these questions, you're really weird! But try Workplace Hazard anyway!
